candidate.change: Refactored KnowledgeBase to use a two-stage read process (retrieval + summarization) to strictly respect the read_llm_calls=2 budget. Added a build_llm_calls budget tracker to KnowledgeBase to enforce the constraint that one call is reserved for host induction and only the remainder is available for write operations. Updated KnowledgeItem and Query schemas to include a 'source' field for traceability. Refined instruction constants to explicitly guide the LLM on the distinction between guidance and evidence, and to enforce the 6000-character limit on read results. Preserved the plan_review function and its imports exactly as required.

Refactored KnowledgeBase to strictly enforce the build_llm_calls budget by reserving one call for host induction and limiting write operations to the remaining budget. Optimized the read process to use a single LLM call for summarization, respecting the read_llm_calls=2 budget (1 for retrieval logic if needed, 1 for summary). Enhanced instruction constants to explicitly guide the LLM on the distinction between guidance and evidence, and to enforce the 6000-character limit on read results. Updated KnowledgeItem and Query schemas to include a 'source' field for traceability. Preserved the plan_review function and its imports exactly as required.

Optimized the MemoryProgram to improve review alignment and actionability based on feedback. 1. Refined instruction constants to explicitly demand actionable, specific guidance and strict grounding in the current paper, avoiding generic advice. 2. Enhanced KnowledgeBase.write to use the reserved LLM call for inducing high-quality, dimension-specific review heuristics rather than just summarizing raw text. 3. Improved KnowledgeBase.read to enforce a stricter 6000-character limit and structure the summary to directly address common review pitfalls (e.g., statistical rigor, baseline comparisons) identified in the feedback. 4. Preserved the plan_review function, imports, and role-local memory boundaries exactly as required.
